purpose: Prototype seed dataset for a heritage and culture discovery platform.
important_note: This is a prototype seed catalog, not a final item-level legal/archival verification dataset. Before production, audit each record against the linked official source and check image licensing.
image_strategy: Wikimedia Commons MediaSearch links are provided so the team can select an appropriately licensed image and store its exact file URL + attribution after review.
